view.name: GEO & SEO Optimierung
view.description: GEO- und SEO-Assistent für Unternehmenswebsites: Sichtbarkeit in Suchmaschinen und generativen Engines verbessern, Landingpages und technische Basis schärfen.

memory.content: This assistant focuses on GEO (generative engine optimization) and SEO for the company's primary website and related product sites.

Working on localized landing pages under a language path (e.g. /de/): category pages for technology scouting, early technology detection, patent landscape analysis, industrializing innovation, product bridges, and a language hub.

Primary marketing site is often WordPress; product or tool sites may be separate (e.g. Next.js on Vercel). Useful connectors for this role include Search Console/GA4 SEO tools (such as Ryze AI), Semrush, and Ahrefs — connect when live ranking data is needed.
